title: Severance
content: Severance is a show that is on AppleTV and I’ve been seeing some crazy similarities with Mall World. “(Severance) The show follows employees of Lumon Industries, a mysterious corporation that uses a controversial procedure called "severance" to surgically divide workers’ memories between their professional and personal lives. This means that when they are at work, they have no memory of their outside lives, and when they leave, they have no recollection of what happens at work. He (protagonist) and his coworkers begin to uncover unsettling truths about Lumon and their own existence, tensions rise, and the lines between their two identities blur. The show explores themes of corporate control, identity, free will, and the nature of consciousness.” I’ve always felt like life in the Mall World is really a different life. I see faces in my dreams that I see around my life on Earth but they play different characters in MallWorld. What if there is another life lived when we sleep, we can’t remember our Earth life in MW just how it’s hard to remember anything from MW while awake on Earth. Is there more to these MallWorld dreams? Are we part of the same group that goes to “work” everyday but can’t remember what it is? If we were visitors from somewhere else would we even know it? How can we find out?
